sources.title: GitHub - jasonacox/TinyLLM: Setup and run a local LLM and Chatbot using ...
sources.snippet: TinyLLM? Yes, the name is a bit of a contradiction, but it means well. It's all about putting a large language model (LLM) on a tiny system that still delivers acceptable performance. This project helps you build a small locally hosted LLM with a ChatGPT-like web interface using consumer grade hardware. To read more about my research with llama.cpp and LLMs, see research.md.
